widgets_values:
This Workflow uses Easy-Use's Loop system to split the full video into manageable Segments. 

Increase or Reduce the Segment Length based on your GPU's capability.  Be sure to match the values used, when stitching the clips back together.

The Frames are first Upscaled using a 2x upscale model, before being processed by Minimax.  

If you change to a 4x upscale model, be sure to downscale back down to a workable resolution.

Be aware, as this workflow loops thru everything before finishing, it will output only the last clip. The only purpose of the 'output' is to force the workflow thru.
